title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped transformers reuse one block of layers many times and are often trained by backpropagating through only the last k loops. We measure how much of the weight gradient this throws away, exactly and for every k from one backward pass, on nine looped language models, and report three findings. First, on a trained model this lost gradient is set near the output: once the loop count is well above k, it barely changes with the loop count (within about 0.03 from 32 to 64 loops on the three models we tested, as a pre-registered test predicted for Parcae). Where the backward signal shrinks, $\rho^k$, with $\rho$ the signal's fitted shrink per loop, approximates it at moderate loop counts but overstates it at long ones, because the fitted $\rho$ drifts up as the fit takes in more loops. translated_title: 循环Transformer中截断反向传播会损失多少梯度？
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过多次重复使用同一组层来构建，并且通常只通过最后k次循环进行反向传播来训练。我们在九个循环语言模型上，精确测量了这种做法在单次反向传播中对每个k值所丢弃的权重梯度比例，并报告了三项发现。第一，在已训练的模型上，这种被损失的梯度在靠近输出的位置就已基本确定：一旦循环次数远大于k，它几乎不再随循环总数变化（在我们测试的三个模型上，从32次到64次循环的变化幅度在约0.03以内，这与一项针对Parcae的预注册测试的预测相符）。在反向信号收缩的情形下，ρ^k（其中ρ为信号每循环拟合出的收缩率）在中等循环次数下能较好地近似该损失，但在长循环次数下会高估它，这是因为随着拟合纳入更多循环，拟合出的ρ会向上漂移。而在Ouro模型上信号是增长的，保留四次循环中的两次仍会损失最终输出梯度的81%。第二，这种损失的梯度在微调过程中会下降，下降了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次在九个循环语言模型上精确量化了截断反向传播（仅反传最后k次循环）所丢弃的权重梯度比例，发现该损失在已训练模型上于靠近输出处即已确定、几乎不随循环总数变化，并在微调过程中逐渐减小。
en_tdlr: This paper precisely quantifies, across nine looped language models, how much weight gradient is discarded by truncated backpropagation (backpropagating only through the last k loops), showing that on trained models this loss is set near the output and barely changes with the loop count once it exceeds k, and that it shrinks during fine-tuning.
